reviewNotes: Held back: not provably public domain: Benjamin Russell Hanby: public domain needs a death year before 1955, work in print before 1850 ("activeBy"), or "traditional": true for an anonymous source; the score has a bar of another length (bar 4), which the solfa grid does not draw. Imported from CCEH tune 001088 (the melody read from 001088a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001088a.nwc).
